== Notes ==
*Not counting elite skills, the longest recharge time for a player-useable attack skill is 30 seconds, which is the recharge time for [[Renewing Smash]]. Aside from Renewing Smash, the longest recharge time is 20 seconds, which is the recharge time of [[Disarm]], [[Overbearing Smash]], [[Bestial Mauling]], [[Disrupting Lunge]], [[Pounce]], and [[Spear Swipe]].
*Often used with energy-based attack skills causing [[knockdown]] such as [[Bull's Strike]], [[Horns of the Ox]] or [[Trampling Ox]] (and with an effect depending on knockdowns such as [[Falling Lotus Strike]] or [[Falling Spider]]) to keep an opponent on the ground.
*Useful for recharging [[dagger attack]]s that have long recharge times.
